crops.text: (1CD) Deal 2 piercing DMG to all other friendly creatures and gain 2 ATK. Every time this activates, increase the amount of piercing DMG and ATK gained by 1.(1PG) May negate one attack directed towards this creature and deal piercing DMG to all other friendly creatures equal to the final DMG of the negated attack.For every friendly prime creature defeated by this creature's ability, gain 2 Max HP, 0.5 DEF, 2 ATK, and 1 SPD.
